# 生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法 (Interim Measures for the Management of Generative AI Services)

gov.cn (State Council portal), sourced from the CAC (国家互联网信息办公室) website. Full text retrieved (24 articles, 5 chapters).

## Key findings (full text)
- **Scope (Art. 2)**: applies to services using generative AI technology to provide the public within the PRC with generated text, images, audio, video, etc. Excludes R&D/application by industry organizations, enterprises, education/research institutions, public cultural institutions, etc. that do not provide services to the domestic public.
- **Principles (Art. 3)**: balance development and security, combine innovation promotion with law-based governance; encourage innovative development; implement tolerant-prudent (包容审慎) and classified/tiered (分类分级) regulation.
- **Prohibited content (Art. 4)**: must uphold core socialist values; no content inciting subversion of state power, endangering national security, inciting separatism, promoting terrorism/extremism, ethnic hatred/discrimination, violence, obscenity, or false/harmful information; must prevent discrimination (ethnic, religious, national, regional, gender, age, occupation, health) in algorithm design, training data selection, model generation/optimization, and service provision; respect IP and commercial ethics; no monopoly/unfair competition; respect others' rights (portrait, reputation, honor, privacy, personal information); improve transparency, accuracy, and reliability of generated content.
- **Technology & governance (Ch. 2)**: encourage innovation applications; support collaboration; encourage independent innovation in algorithms, frameworks, chips, and supporting software platforms; equal-mutual-benefit international exchange and participation in international rule-making; build AI infrastructure and public training-data platforms; promote computing-resource sharing; orderly opening of public data by category/tier.
- **Training data (Art. 7)**: providers must lawfully conduct pre-training/optimization training data processing — use legally sourced data and base models; no IP infringement; personal information requires consent or legal basis; improve training-data quality (authenticity, accuracy, objectivity, diversity).
- **Data annotation (Art. 8)**: clear, specific, operable annotation rules; quality assessment and sampling verification; training for annotators.
- **Service norms (Ch. 3)**: providers bear network-information content producer responsibility; sign service agreements; disclose applicable population/occasion/use; prevent minors' over-reliance/addiction; protect user input info and usage records (no unnecessary personal info collection, no illegal retention of identity-identifying inputs, no illegal provision to others); label generated images/video per the Provisions on the Administration of Deep Synthesis of Internet Information Services; provide safe/stable/continuous service; stop generation/transmission and rectify upon finding illegal content; establish complaint/reporting mechanisms.
- **Supervision & liability (Ch. 4)**: CAC, NDRC, education, science & tech, MIIT, public security, radio & TV, press & publication departments manage per their duties; services with public-opinion attributes or social-mobilization capacity must undergo security assessment and algorithm filing (per the Algorithmic Recommendation Provisions); users may complain/report; providers must cooperate with supervision (explain training-data source, scale, type, annotation rules, algorithm mechanism); cross-border services from outside the PRC violating the rules — CAC notifies relevant institutions to take technical measures; violations punished per the Cybersecurity Law, Data Security Law, Personal Information Protection Law, and Science & Technology Progress Law; where no provision, warning, public criticism, ordered rectification; refusal or serious cases — ordered suspension of the relevant service.
- **Definitions (Art. 22)**: generative AI technology = models and related technology with content-generation capability (text, image, audio, video); provider = organizations/individuals providing generative AI services (including via programmable interfaces).
- **Effective date (Art. 24)**: **August 15, 2023**.
